card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on small linking words, commas and brackets before a name or term (for, by, in, a comma in a list), plus a few partial names or numbers.

modes.description: Short words like for, by, in or a comma that come just before a proper name or technical term.
modes.example: He was replaced<< by>> Armando Diaz and Pietro Badog
